contract: After opening an asset from the mobile map and returning, moving or zooming the map must continue updating the visible nearby assets without reopening the map view.
symptoms: Map results update normally before an asset is opened.
After returning from the asset viewer, moving or zooming the map leaves the previously visible assets stuck.
Leaving the map view and opening it again restores updates.
reproduction: Open Places / map view in the mobile app.
Move or zoom to an area and open one of the visible assets.
Move or zoom again and verify whether nearby assets refresh.

runtime.notes: Historical mobile case. Confirm the repository-pinned Flutter/Dart toolchain before running tests.

validation.guidance: Prefer a narrow regression test or deterministic route/navigation-state probe before the full mobile suite.
